allow: PowerShell($pages = @\('/', '/about', '/events', '/contact', '/this-does-not-exist'\); foreach \($p in $pages\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "$p -> $\($r.StatusCode\)  \($\([math]::Round\($r.RawContentLength/1024,1\)\) KB\)" } catch { "$p -> ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message.Split\([Environment]::NewLine\)[0]\)" } })

PowerShell($h = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing\).Content; "Has 'दिल्ली': $\($h -match 'दिल्ली'\)"; "Has 'Skating Community': $\($h -match 'Skating Community'\)"; "Has 'Upcoming events' header: $\($h -match 'Upcoming events'\)"; "Has Sunday Skate event: $\($h -match 'Sunday Skate at Connaught Place'\)"; "Has Hero CTA: $\($h -match 'See upcoming events'\)"; "Has Footer IG handle: $\($h -match '@delhiskatingcommunity'\)"; "---events---"; $e = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/events" -UseBasicParsing\).Content; "Events page has Past events: $\($e -match 'Past events'\)"; "Events page has Holi Skate \(past\): $\($e -match 'Holi Skate Meetup'\)"; "Events page has Register button: $\($e -match '>Register<'\)")
